top_story.title: How major US stock indexes fared Tuesday 6/2/2026
top_story.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 0.4%, and the Nasdaq composite rose less than 0.1%.  Marvell Technology leaped to its biggest gain on record after Nvidia’s CEO suggested it could be the next company to be worth $1 trillion.  The Nasdaq composite rose 7.09 points, or less than 0.1%, to 27,093.90.
